title: Drummer George Howe points him to the Nest Club
summary: Back in New York, his old drummer tells him that Johnny Carey and Mal Frazier are opening a new club and need a bandleader.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: And I got back to New York -- now, this is where, where the really, the things start turning over now, see? I got back to New York and I walked into my drummer, the fellow that had been in the Army with me, George Howe. George Howe said, 'Sam,

Johnny Carey and Mal Frazier is looking for"-- that was the Nest -- "they're opening a new club called the Nest Club, and they're looking for somebody to take the band. And I told them that you would be in town and you had worked for Old Man Baron." And they'd been down to Old Man Baron, and Baron'd said that Sam is a good man, get him if you can, see? Said he's a conscientious kid, see? So --
That's how you got into the Nest.
